window.note: An exemption written in code now stands only if it cites a CONFIRMED ruling or states an impossibility, and the entry declares WHICH of the two it is, so nothing has to read English to decide. Eight sites are declared, one of them this set itself, which is what makes narrowing the set fire the check. Every entry names a symbol the sieve asserts is still at the declared path, so a reason outlives its code by exactly zero commits. 47 teeth green twice and sealed; the hollow runner measured 5 files, 0 hollow, after saying no three times for three different reasons. Akien's rule that nothing in an inspector or a gate may be an LLM holds by construction here: the entry declares its kind and the sieve only resolves that kind's evidence, so there is no place a judgement could be delegated. This does NOT clear the 187: it gives the eight that survive a shape, and the probe is what finds the rest.
